summary: Phase 3 — API Widget Sources backend tested end-to-end. 19/19 functional tests pass: providers list (11 entries, credentials hidden, admin gating), test-api stealth-only gating + coming_soon/missing-key/unknown error paths, editor_config api validation, full from-template/launch/api-call flow with L1 cache verification, api-call gating (401/403/200), and provider per-minute rate-limit 429 confirmed firing. Frontend smoke skipped after hitting login-flow selector issues twice (loop-prevention) — backend smoke validates all critical Phase 3 paths and main agent confirmed manual frontend smoke already passes.

minor.issue: Provider per-minute burst uses a FIXED-minute bucket keyed on strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M'). At a minute boundary the counter resets, so a burst straddling :59→:00 can deliver up to 2x the cap (e.g. 60 in :59 + 60 in :00) before any 429. A sliding-window or token-bucket would be tighter. Not blocking for Phase 3 MVP.

_execute() raises HTTPException(status_code=502, ...) on ALL upstream non-2xx responses. CoinGecko 429/Cloudflare 1015 are surfaced to the caller as 502 instead of being passed through as 429, which makes downstream caches harder to throttle properly. Consider forwarding 429 as 429.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Switch rate-limit window to sliding (60s rolling) instead of fixed-minute buckets — current behaviour can permit 2x cap across boundary.
OPTIONAL: Forward upstream 429/5xx status codes through the proxy (currently flattened to 502).
FYI: After running the rate-limit smoke test, CoinGecko's CDN may briefly Cloudflare-block the egress IP — subsequent CoinGecko tests in the same minute may return 502. Self-clears in ~60s.
critical_code_review_comments: core/api_providers.public_provider_view() correctly strips auth_env_var AND auth_param_prefix from the public payload — credentials cannot leak to frontend. Verified.
routers/api_widgets._require_stealth uses lowercase username match — correct.
routers/api_widgets widget_api_call: draft widgets correctly hidden from non-admins (404) but visible to any admin tier — matches spec.
routers/admin_widgets._validate_editor_config: catches unknown provider/endpoint/non-object params/non-object response_map. Validation passes all spec cases.
services/api_widget_proxy.call_api: ordering is correct — provider/endpoint/coming_soon/credential checks fire BEFORE rate-limit increments, so error responses don't burn quota. Good.
services/api_widget_proxy._cache_put: ttl_seconds=0 falls through `int(0 or 60) = 60` → cache silently gets 60s TTL even when caller passes 0. Surprising but not test-breaking.

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 functional tests; 19/19 in baseline run before burst test poisoned CoinGecko egress)
success_rate.frontend: not_tested (login UI blocked automated flow; main agent confirmed manual smoke passes)
